name: Hinagiku
source: A shrine maiden living with her father, the village priest. She lost her mother in a battle against the evil god eight years ago and struggles with self-confidence. Still, she admires her mother and endures her father’s strict training every day to get closer to that ideal. She takes care of the protagonist and Dejiko, who wandered into this world.
